name: ai.limitguard.api/trust-intelligence
title: Limitguard Lead Verification
description: Lead validation over MCP: KVK/KBO register, EU VAT, sanctions and email checks with sources.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer lg_live_... -- the full header value, 'Bearer ' included. Free key: POST https://api.limitguard.ai/v1/keys/create with an email.

tools.name: check_entity
tools.description: Company check on a business: sanctions screening and country risk, the Dutch KVK register for an NL company, and the website domain when you send it. Returns trust_score (0-100, 100 = best), trust_level (high means low risk), cluster, recommendation, confidence, top_factors and sources_checked.

entity_name.description: Full legal name of the entity

tools.name: get_trust_score
tools.description: Look up your own most recent trust score for an entity you checked before, from your stored checks: score, level, when, which product, trend and how many checks are on record. Runs no new check and calls no data source. Free ($0).

entity_id.description: Entity name, as sent to check_entity

tools.name: verify_wallet
tools.description: Screen a wallet: OFAC SDN address match, on-chain signals (contract check, native and USDC balance, transaction count, first seen on Base) and named risk rules with up to 3 advice items. On Base, also reports any ERC-8004 agent the wallet owns and its open on-chain reputation as descriptive signals, never scored. $0.11. Supports EVM and Solana addresses.

chain_id.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (default: eip155:8453 for Base); base, eth, solana, btc also accepted

tools.name: get_risk_score
tools.description: Quick risk score from sanctions screening and country risk only, without the register or domain lookups of check_entity. Returns risk_score (0-100, 100 = riskiest), risk_level (high means high risk, the reverse of check_entity's trust_level), sanctions_match and fatf_status; no recommendation or factors.

entity_name.description: Full legal name of the entity

tools.name: get_compliance_report
tools.description: Per-entity report built from one real check: registry identity, sanctions and PEP screens, domain signals, risk score with the rules that fired, correlations, every finding as a ranked action, a per-source status table (ok / unavailable / error) and a report hash.

entity_name.description: Full legal name (with country; omit when sending check_id)

cbe_number.description: Optional Belgian CBE number (0XXX.XXX.XXX or 10 digits)

wallet_address.description: Optional crypto wallet address (format check only)

wallet_chain.description: Optional chain for wallet_address (eth, base, btc, sol, ...)

check_id.description: Id of a check from an earlier report, instead of identifiers

tools.name: sanctions_preview
tools.description: Free yes/no sanctions preview against the local OFAC SDN, EU and UN lists. Returns possible_match, lists_checked and list_dates only, never an entry. 10 per caller per UTC day.

name.description: Company or person name to screen

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (orders matches, never excludes one)

tools.name: wallet_sanctions_preview
tools.description: Free yes/no check of a wallet address against the OFAC SDN list: sanctioned, lists, the list date and its freshness, no programmes or entry ids. 10 per caller per UTC day, separate from sanctions_preview. The full wallet screen is verify_wallet ($0.11).

chain_id.description: CAIP-2 chain ID (default: eip155:8453 for Base); base, eth, solana, btc also accepted

tools.name: sanctions_screen
tools.description: Sanctions screen against the local OFAC SDN, EU and UN lists: matched entries with list, entry id, programmes, countries, listing date and match score. A name match is not a determination.

name.description: Company or person name to screen

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (orders matches, never excludes one)

tools.name: check_agent_wallet
tools.description: Check a counterparty agent's EVM wallet in one call: OFAC SDN digital-currency address list match, Base USDC and ETH balance, ERC-8004 identity registration (and, given an agent id, that agent's owner and payment wallet) and open ERC-8004 feedback, which is not scored. $0.75.

agent_id.description: Optional ERC-8004 agentId (decimal) the wallet claims

domain.description: Optional website domain the agent gives for itself (e.g. example.com)

tools.name: verify_lead
tools.description: Verify a NL/BE sales lead against the registers in one call: real and active, VAT, mail server, IBAN, sanctions; a 0-100 lead score. $0.27.

name.description: Company name as the lead gave it (NL without a number)

vat_number.description: EU VAT number, checked with VIES

email.description: Contact email; only its domain is checked

address.description: {street, house_number, postcode, city} the lead gave

iban.description: IBAN the lead gave; only country, bank, BIC and last 4 are returned

phone.description: Phone number the lead gave; compared with the numbers the company publishes, never echoed. Rejected until website phone lookup is switched on

target_industries.description: Ideal-customer industries: SBI/NACE code prefixes ("62") or whole words; information only

target_size.description: Ideal-customer employee range {min, max}, both inclusive; information only
